key.headline: 1.2× feasible with reflux cut or new shell
key.request:
Engineering loop, next round. Goal: +20 % feed: what limits it first and what does it cost? Make the design pass every engineering check that has data.
The current design (verified changes: No capex: cut reflux to 0.8 to stay below flood at 1.2×) was re-solved and checked by the engines. These checks FAIL:
- proposal rejected: New 600 mm ID shell for 1.2× at design reflux (replace K 2750) - corrected physical replacement: change 2 cannot raise existing limit K 2750.diameter_m
Propose physical changes that fix each failed check (equipment, ratings with a real item behind them, operating settings within documented limits), cheapest first. Return the FULL design as proposals: every earlier verified change you keep plus the new ones, so the design answer stands on its own. Do not edit a limit to pass a check. If a failure cannot be fixed with the information available, start the headline with 'UNSOLVABLE:' and say why and what data would settle it.
titles: No capex: cut reflux to 0.8 to stay below flood at 1.2×
